parts.title: Overview
parts.body:
This benefit helps people on a low income with everyday living costs. You may be able to claim if you are over the qualifying age and live in the UK.

You can claim online, by phone or by post. It usually takes a few weeks for your first payment to arrive, so plan ahead.

parts.title: How much you get
parts.body:
Weekly rates

The full weekly rate is £184.90 and it is reviewed every April.

  • Your payment can be lower if you have gaps in your record.
  • You can check your record online.
